1. Mr. T.A. Khan Senior Advocate assisted 
by Mr. Vinay Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
applicants.
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned AGA for 
the State.
3. Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik, learned 
counsel for the private respondent.
4. Both the parties are present along with 
the child. Prima facie the dispute appears to be 
matrimonial one.
5. All the parties along with the child and 
their family members are directed to appear 
before the Counsellor today itself.
6. The Counsellor firstly interacts with the 
husband Sheikh Asif then with the wife Smt.
Nishat Anjum and then interact with both of 
them and thereafter interact with the family 
members in the presence of both Sheikh Asif 
and Nishat Anjum and then submit a report.
7. List this case on 11.06.2026.

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C528 No.308 of 2026
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Mr. T.A. Khan, learned senior counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Tumul K. Nainwal, learned AGA, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik, learned counsel or 
the complainant.
4. Parties are present in person before this Court.
5. On the previous date, the parties were directed to 
appear before the Counsellor since the dispute prima 
facie due to the matrimonial discord in between the 
applicant no.2 and the respondent no.3. 
6. The Counsellor submitted its report. As per the 
Counsellor report, it reveals that the matrimonial 
dispute now converted to dispute relating to property.
7. Pleadings are exchanged.
8. List this matter for final hearing on 06.07.2026.
9. In the meantime, the applicant no.2 and the 
respondent no.3 are directed to think over it for their 
amicable settlement and then apprise to this Court on 
the next date fixed. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 16.06.2026
Nitesh/
